items.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.title_zh: OpenAI 宣称 AI 破解纳维–斯托克斯千禧年难题，引发功劳争议
items.title_en: OpenAI Claims AI Cracked Navier–Stokes Problem, Sparking Credit Dispute
items.summary: OpenAI claims its unreleased model produced a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, a historic milestone clouded by accusations of misconduct from academic collaborators.

items.title_en: Tim Cook to Skip Apple Event Video, New CEO Ternus to Lead Foldable iPhone Launch
items.summary: 据彭博社报道，库克将缺席苹果九月发布会视频，由新任CEO John Ternus主导推出折叠iPhone。

items.title_en: ASML and TSMC Partner to Advance High NA EUV with 12-Inch Photomasks
items.summary: ASML与台积电宣布合作推进High NA EUV光刻机升级，计划2031年建立12英寸光掩模试产线，2033年用于先进制程量产。

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.0 强化文本渲染与联网推理能力  OpenAI 推出基于 GPT Image 2 的新一代图像生成模型
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.0，引入推理与联网搜索
items.title_en: OpenAI Releases ChatGPT Images 2.0 with Reasoning and Web Search
items.summary: OpenAI has released ChatGPT Images 2.0 based on GPT Image 2, introducing reasoning and web search to generate up to 8 visually consistent images and solve text rendering issues for non-Latin scripts.

items.title: NeurIPS desk-rejected 178 papers for being "AI-generated". The detector flagged the track chairs' own papers at 24-69% [N]
items.title_zh: NeurIPS 用不可靠 AI 检测器拒稿 178 篇论文，检测器连主席论文也误判
items.title_en: NeurIPS Desk-Rejects 178 Papers Using Unreliable AI Detector That Flagged Its Own Chairs
items.summary: NeurIPS desk-rejected 178 papers based on an unreliable AI detector that even flagged track chairs' own papers as AI-generated at rates of 24-69%.
